D: A Melbourne family fights to keep their home next to the airport from being compulsorily acquired.
P: Serve the mains when Darryl asks Sal what's for tea.
S: Sal's party pies and sausage rolls

Homemade sausage rolls with carrot and thyme and little beef party pies in flaky pastry, piping hot with a big bowl of tomato sauce. Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion, 1 grated carrot, thyme and 40g breadcrumbs. Roll in 2 halved puff pastry sheets, egg wash and cut into 16. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 onion, add 1 tbsp flour, 200ml stock and Worcestershire and simmer 15 minutes, then cool. Line 12 patty tins with shortcrust rounds, fill, top with puff and egg wash. Bake everything at 200C for 25 minutes.
the holiday shack at Bonnie Doon
Kabana sliced on the diagonal, cubes of tasty cheese, round butter crackers and pickled onions, toothpicks in, on a plastic platter.
it's going straight to the pool room
Cooked king prawns peeled, piled on ice with a Marie Rose sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire and lemon, wedges on the side.
M: Darryl tells her it's beautiful every night
Beef mince with grated onion, carrot, an egg, breadcrumbs and a splash of Worcestershire, shaped and fried in a hot pan until browned, finished in onion gravy. Mash and peas.
the family barbie under the power lines

Thick beef snags and rosemary garlic lamb chops off the hotplate, fried onions, buttered white bread and a creamy potato salad, Darryl's way. Marinate 8 lamb loin chops in olive oil, rosemary and 2 crushed garlic cloves for 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes, cool and toss with 150g mayonnaise, chopped spring onion and parsley. Cook 8 thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate with oil until soft. Grill the chops 3 minutes a side. Serve with buttered white bread and tomato sauce.
W: Sal goes all out for a special occasion
Eggs and sugar whisked 10 minutes until pale and thick, cornflour and flour sifted and folded in, baked at 180C for 20 minutes, filled with jam and cream, icing sugar on top.
K: Bonnie Doon lager and lime shandy

Ice-cold Aussie lager topped with lemonade and fresh lime over ice, poured into chilled pot glasses with a lime wedge. Chill 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each. Pour 200ml cold Australian lager into each glass, tilting it, then top with 150ml cold lemonade. Stir once gently and add a lime wedge. Make lemon, lime and lemonade ones for the kids and the driver.

s.note: the holiday shack at Bonnie Doon
s.how: Slice 250g kabana on the diagonal and cut 250g tasty cheese into cubes. Thread onto toothpicks with pickled onions. Lay out on a plastic platter with round butter crackers. It's the vibe.

s.note: it's going straight to the pool room
s.how: Peel 750g cooked king prawns, leaving the tails on. Pile on crushed ice. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, a dash of Worcestershire and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges, and put the platter in the pool room after.

m.note: Darryl tells her it's beautiful every night
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion and carrot, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs and Worcestershire. Shape into 8 rissoles and fry until browned. Make gravy with a sliced onion, flour and 400ml stock, then simmer the rissoles in it. Serve with mash and 300g peas.

w.note: Sal goes all out for a special occasion
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g caster sugar for 10 minutes until pale and thick. Sift over 60g cornflour and 60g flour with 1 tsp baking powder and fold gently. Bake in two tins at 180C for 20 minutes. Fill with jam and 300ml whipped cream and dust with icing sugar.

d.n: Bonnie Doon lager and lime shandy
d.how: Chill 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each. Pour 200ml cold Australian lager into each glass, tilting it, then top with 150ml cold lemonade. Stir once gently and add a lime wedge. Make lemon, lime and lemonade ones for the kids and the driver.
